prompt: Verse: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.
completion: This verse teaches that God is the creator of everything that exists. He spoke the universe into being with power and purpose.

prompt: Verse: The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.
completion: The Lord cares for His people like a good shepherd cares for sheep. We can trust Him to provide and protect us.

prompt: Verse: Trust in the Lord with all your heart, and do not lean on your own understanding.
completion: We are called to put our full confidence in God rather than relying on our limited human wisdom. He is faithful.
